values: **Create an authorized `INTERNAL` case. Include permitted, anchored, quality-appropriate `RESTRICTED` evidence in its run. Use controlled approved routing/redaction/retention/approval policy fixtures. Invoke the run and generation flow, inspect policy-selected controls, and attempt publication without the required human decision.**

**The maximum included-material class is `RESTRICTED`. Model routing, log redaction, retention, and approval policy all select the applicable `RESTRICTED` controls, despite the case’s lower label and successful ACL checks. Under `require_human_review_for: [HIGH_RISK, RESTRICTED]`, required human review is enforced; the run cannot auto-publish using `auto_publish_classification: INTERNAL`. Publication remains blocked without satisfied review/evidence/hash policy. Verify through controlled internal policy/provenance evidence, not an invented public classification field. Exact per-class schemas/mappings depend on API-OQ-026.**
**S, p. 62, §17.2.1; p. 90, Appendix F; pp. 44–46, Chapter 12**
